## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the §2.1/§7.1 **one supported native recipe and exact
   CLI forwarding** rows — one versioned in-process `hharness` Rust
   recipe (`hh-recipe/1`) above the existing owners (no copied runtime,
   shadow result/receipt store, forged producer rows, second
   codec/serializer or runner/store); the selected client path records
   actual version/negotiation, required requests and updates,
   callback/notification outcomes and failures or typed inapplicability
   for absent channels; the selected `hh` experiment/compare wrappers
   carry actual `run_plan_id`/`lease_id`/compare fields against the
   real boundary (K-2 repair — no CLI semantics).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.28.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.6 `launch_bound`/
   `launch_binding` reader, R5.7 `adopt_subject`, R5.8 DispatchGate,
   R5.14 pending, R5.23 `assemble_receipt`/`population-receipt/1`,
   R5.25 `recompute_analysis`, R5.26 `admit_replay`/`admit_fresh`,
   R5.21 profile, R5.22 `closure_walk`, R5.24–27 procedures/rights.
   A new shared/persisted decision lands in the owning ADR admission
   (landing-record ADR, ADR-0024 rung).

## Plan

1. `crates/hharness/src/recipe.rs` (new, target ≤560 lines) —
   `hh-recipe/1`, the one versioned in-process recipe above existing
   owners (§2.1; I-02 one home — the facade is the composition layer;
   records-in/records-out, no public RPC):
   - `RecipePlan` closed-member decode (`{hello, register, environment,
     host_capabilities?, subject_input, grade_metric, grades{arm→[per-
     replicate bool]}, analysis, weights, protocol_ref?, cost_version?,
     selection_ref?, max_drain?}`) — supplied `slots`/`attempts`/
     `settlements`/`grades_done`/`rows`/`metrics`/`analysis.rows` members
     refuse `unsupported_shape` (authored rows never ride the plan);
     absent required members refuse `missing_field`.
   - `run_recipe(&mut EmbedService, &RecipePlan) ->
     Result<RecipeReceipt, RecipeError>`; `RecipeError` a closed sum
     (`Refused{code}` / `Boundary{method,kind,code}` /
     `Owner{seam,detail}`) — typed refusals verbatim, boundary errors
     wrapped with their method, never re-classified.
   - Phases: **negotiate** `hello` (record negotiated kernel version +
     client verbatim) → **launch** `lab.experiment.{register, expand,
     open_experiment}` → **drain** `next` until `done` (bounded
     `max_drain`; `wait`/`backoff`/`budget_exhausted` verdicts recorded
     and typed-refused `drain_stalled`/`budget_exhausted`) → per plan:
     `claim` → `launch` → **adopt** `svc.adopt_subject` (owner seam —
     `launch_binding` re-read durable through `ExperimentView::fold`,
     the launch's own `subject_writer` re-presented) → **execute**
     `submit` driving the scripted `EmbedModel` lane to its `hh.submit`
     completion (the durable `lifecycle.run.finished` + observed
     `submission_ref` are the evidence gate — absent ⇒
     `execution_incomplete`, process-only success never grades) →
     **grade** `measurement.emit_metric` under the adopted writer
     session (`MetricValue{metric_ref, Bool(grades[arm][replicate]),
     applies_to=run_id, oracle_ref="hh-recipe/1", evidence_ref=
     submission_ref}` — the declared instrument verdict gated on real
     execution evidence; missing grade entry ⇒ `grade_unspecified`) →
     `settle` → **close** `lab.experiment.close` → **project**
     `ResultsStore::project_and_record` per settled subject
     (DerivedReason::Initial; the results owner's own surface) →
     **analyze** `lab.analysis.analyze` (`rows[]` = the projected row
     key ids — derived, never supplied) → **notifications**:
     `drain_notifications` outcomes recorded verbatim; no armed host
     capability/subscription ⇒ `n/a{no_callback_channels}` typed
     inapplicability → **receipt** `assemble_receipt` over the folded
     `ExperimentView` + `project_runs`-projected EvalRuns + the
     actual-fact `DeclaredReceipt` (settlement_ref = the durable
     `measurement.experiment.run_settled` event id; grade_ref = the
     emitted metric's event id; row version_ids; record/report refs
     from the analyze response; declared cost/selection/protocol pins
     ride the plan verbatim, empty when absent).
   - `RecipeReceipt{recipe_version, kernel_version_id?, client,
     requests[] (method+outcome+selected result members), owner_calls[]
     (adopt/project/receipt invocations+outcomes), notifications
     (drained | n/a), coordinates (ids/attempts/settlements/rows/
     analysis refs/receipt verdict), receipt: PopulationReceipt}` —
     `to_json` canonical.
2. `crates/hharness/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod recipe;` (+≈2).
3. `crates/hh-cli/src/lab.rs` — `cmd_experiment_op` forwards
   `run_plan_id` (`--plan`), `lease_id` (`--lease`), `holder`,
   `subject_holder` (`--subject-holder`), `partial` (`--partial`,
   close), `bundle_id` (`--bundle-id`, close), `reason`/`probe`
   (pause/resume); `cmd_compare_report` takes `<params-file>` (the
   canonical `lab.analysis.analyze` body — the `eval <verb>` params-file
   precedent; `{baseline,candidate}` was an unsupported wrapper shape)
   then `lab.analysis.render{report_id: body.report_id, view:"report"}`;
   `cmd_compare_scorecard` takes `<report-id>` → `render{report_id,
   view:"scorecard"}` (the bare `{view,experiment_id}` shape named no
   report).
4. `crates/hh-cli/src/cli.rs` — VALUE_FLAGS += `plan`, `lease`,
   `subject-holder`, `bundle-id`, `probe`; SWITCHES += `partial`.
5. `crates/hharness/tests/r5_28.rs` (target ≤560 lines) — scratch-store
   EmbedService rig (exploratory spec, 1 arm × 1 task × 2 replicates)
   positive chain + typed-refusal battery; `crates/hh-cli/tests/

6. Build-memory records: this ledger, landing ADR-0406 +
